relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study indicates that both galcanezumab and prednisone decrease the frequency of headaches in patients with MOH.

relationships.subject: prednisone
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study indicates that both galcanezumab and prednisone decrease the frequency of headaches in patients with MOH.

key_findings: In 75 MOH patients, galcanezumab, galcanezumab plus prednisone and prednisone all reduced monthly headache days; combination gave the greatest reduction (25 to 7 days)
Prednisone had a higher incidence of side effects (P=0.002)
